p.i: Humana vani somnia gaudij, Currant ut ala tardiore Flumina, tela, leues & Austri.

main_text.head: IIII. GAL.
main_text.p: TU me feras tesmoin, ô incôstante France, Qu'au Monde n'y a rien, qu'une vaine in-constance: Car ta paix est ta guerre,& ta guerre est ta paix, Ton plaisir te desplait, & ton soulas t'ennuye: Tu crois qu'en te tuant, tu sauueras ta vie, Flotant sur l'incertain de contraires effects. Il n'y a chose en toy qui ferme se maintiene: Et n'as rien de cōstant, que l'inconstance tiene.
main_text.head: LAT.

p.i: TESTIS mearum Gallia civicis Turbata longo tempore motibus Sententiarum, quod sub axe Sorte vaga fluitamus omnes Utróque. Parta nónne ferocior In pace gaudet spargere latius Strages? Dolosa nónne pacis Otia Marte petit relicto? Mox qua petebat nunc procul abijcit, Poscitque si quid nuper omiserat. Solere! contra tristiori

page.notes: Faint printed cross marks ("+") in the right margin beside the first and fourth lines of the French poem; they may be printer's marks and are not transcribed as text. "relicto" is read as "reliclo" on the scan; the letters after "reli" are doubtful: [?] would apply. The signature "G 4" is read from a worn gathering mark; the first letter is doubtful. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The printed "f" forms (tefmoin, foulas, fur, chofe, fe, fubaxe) were read as long s. Latin accents on "Utróque" and "nónne" are as printed.
